title: Updates to the Statement of Solicitor Competence and FLK proposed
summary: The SRA is consulting on updates to the Statement of Solicitor Competence, which sets the competence standards expected of all solicitors throughout their careers, and to the SQE functioning legal knowledge.
what_changes: Proposed competence updates cover use of technology and AI, supervision, health and wellbeing, and professional conduct and ethics.
Proposed changes to functioning legal knowledge (FLK) would add clarity and add or remove content.
The SRA plans to publish the final statement and FLK in April, taking effect from September.
who_it_applies_to: All SRA-regulated solicitors and the firms that employ and supervise them, plus SQE candidates.
